integrity: The proof is symbolic. It uses the max-of-two-quadratics representation of the norm, an exact mixed-branch lower bound, a one-variable constrained maximization, and strict-branch comparison pairs approaching the unit-ball junction. No numerical experiment, external certification, or unproved computational certificate is used.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the right derivative at tau=0 for the real two-dimensional Banaś–Frączek plane. It does not give the full small-skew profile, classify positive-skew minimizers, or treat complex or higher-dimensional analogues. One close 2025 comparison was available only at abstract level, leaving a stated residual originality risk.
title: A sharp small-skew phase transition in the Banaś–Frączek plane
